title: chionanthus foveolatus subsp. major
intro: Chionanthus foveolatus subsp. major, commonly known as the 'Fragrant Chaste Tree', is a plant species known for its medicinal and aromatic properties. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. Therapeutically, Chionanthus foveolatus subsp. major is used as an antispasmodic, antitussive, and diaphoretic, helping to relieve muscle spasms, coughs, and promote sweating. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aroma.
